context.zh: 个人项目，使用 Codex Agents 协作
context.en: Solo project developed with Codex Agents

summary.zh: 4-6 人实时风险决策游戏，将探险中的继续/退出选择、个性化报价、矿料加工和矿坑成长连接为长期循环。
summary.en: A 4-6 player real-time risk-decision game connecting continue-or-exit expeditions, personalized pricing, material processing, and mine progression.

zh: 用公开风险与私人报价制造玩家间决策张力
让矿料加工和矿坑成长承接单局结算
en: Create decision tension through public risk and private pricing
Connect match settlement to material processing and mine growth

zh: 35 张牌组、逐张继续或退出、4-6 人房间
个性化报价、原子支付准备、矿料平面重复切割
en: 35-card deck, card-by-card continue or exit decisions, and 4-6 player rooms
Personalized pricing, atomic pay-and-ready, and repeatable planar material cuts

zh: 房主、矿主和玩家身份分离
服务器仅公开已暴露表面和允许观察的状态
en: Host, mine owner, and player identities are separate
The server exposes only visible surfaces and allow-listed observable state

zh: 以玩法测试矩阵区分已确认、未实现和需人工验证内容
Terminal 原型演示连续两次报价、探险与加工循环
en: A gameplay matrix separates confirmed, missing, and manual-validation behavior
The terminal prototype demonstrates two consecutive pricing, expedition, and processing loops

zh: 设计 4-6 人实时探险玩法，以继续/退出、个性化报价、矿料加工与矿坑成长构成风险收益循环。
使用 Codex Agents 建立玩法规格与验证矩阵，通过权威服务器原型验证隐藏信息和结算一致性。
en: Designed a 4-6 player real-time expedition and progression loop.
Used agent-assisted specifications and an authoritative prototype to validate hidden information and settlement consistency.

website.zh: 《寻宝游戏》围绕多人探险中的继续与退出选择展开，并把私人报价、资源加工和矿坑成长连接为可扩展的长期系统。
website.en: Modular Mining Game centers on multiplayer continue-or-exit expedition choices and connects private pricing, resource processing, and mine growth into an extensible long-term system.

full.zh: 当前版本是 Go 权威核心技术原型，已实现多人房间、正式牌组、逐人报价、准备与开局、探险结算以及矿料重复切割。Godot 客户端和长期维护系统尚未完成。
full.en: The current Go authoritative-core prototype implements multiplayer rooms, the production deck, per-player quotes, readiness and match start, expedition settlement, and repeatable material cutting. The Godot client and long-term maintenance systems remain incomplete.
